limits: Offline, read-only views. Registries and reports are self-asserted: records prove binding, not authenticity; an evaluation report is not re-derived from a registration, verdict records or costs because the CLI has no codec for those inputs. registry-status does not resolve a profile against a current identity. The evidence inventory hashes bytes and matches task evidence only by evidence/<task>.json; contents, claims and checkbox state are not verified. Synthetic test doubles only; no host, model, network or native activation. ProfileRegistry gained read-only active and revoked properties so the CLI does not re-implement journal replay. Pre-PR reviews were Claude subagents, not independent review.
method: Actual offline unittest execution and command smoke runs in a temporary directory
outcome: Four read-only harness subcommands print bounded JSON with executionAuthorization false and refuse invalid, unverifiable, unreadable or oversized input with exit 2 and a fixed reason. capabilities lists every harness command and its effect (only prepare has one), automaticPromotion false, no plugin/MCP surface and untouched global host instructions. registry-status decodes a T013 registry with ProfileRegistry.from_bytes (canonical bytes, journal replay, decision hashes) and reports active/pending/previous/revoked state and the audit trail. evaluation-summary checks a trusted --sha256 against the raw bytes first, then canonical JSON, the T003 report format, cohort, identity hashes, summary keys and counts, and summarizes strata and comparisons. evidence walks a spec's evidence/ tree by directory descriptor (no symlinks or special files, 256 files, 1,024 entries, three nested levels, 1 MiB per file) and cross-references tasks.md checkboxes, flagging checked tasks without evidence and files claiming executionAuthorization true.
